tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is HTTPS everywhere, with no plain-text exception: internal hosts must not use plain HTTP either, since certificate management is already in place to support this. For testing, self-signed certificates are used.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/internal-http.md`. It has a single paragraph saying the current decision is HTTPS everywhere, with no plain-text exception. Internal hosts are covered too, because certificate management is already in place. It also notes that testing uses self-signed certificates.

The earlier decision that allowed plain HTTP for internal hosts (because they sit behind the firewall) has been replaced by this one. I left it out of the file, as you asked.
